title: The Pedigree Embryo Vault
logline: An orbital cattle rancher hires a pilot to extract prize centrifugal dairy embryos before a predatory syndicate forecloses on her livestock ring to satisfy an off-books debt.

roles.description: An independent orbital livestock rancher; practical, proud of her centrifugal dairy herd, fighting foreclosure.
A ruthless repo agent enforcing off-ledger syndicate loan liens across agricultural habitats.
A reinforced industrial tug fitted with heavy magnetic hull clamps and short-range pulse lasers.
The dominant credit corporation controlling agricultural equipment leases across the system.
A rotating habitat ring housing three hundred dairy cattle in simulated gravity stalls.
The agricultural exchange dock where repossessed livestock lots are liquidated.

public_situation: Bidding opens at {role:auction_terminal} for liquidated agricultural assets as {role:livestock_syndicate} moves to foreclose on independent dairy habitats.
private_truth: {role:debt_enforcer} is foreclosing on {role:orbital_herder}'s centrifuge using an unverified debt note signed by her deceased business partner with usurious compound interest.

beats.public_change: Syndicate factors cut auxiliary utility feeds to {role:herder_centrifuge}, threatening cryogenic life-support systems.

missions.reason: She needs an independent pilot to dock at her failing centrifuge ring and extract the frozen pedigree embryo canister before temperatures rise.
missions.private_fact: She mortgaged her personal ship to buy the liquid nitrogen cylinders keeping the vat core chilled.

beats.public_change: {role:livestock_syndicate} posts an automated asset warrant on the station net, offering a recovery bounty for the extracted embryo canister.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to scan the syndicate registry exchange and prove the partner's promissory note carried illegal compounding interest rates.
missions.private_fact: Her late partner took the loan to pay off clandestine wagering losses at the station dog track.

beats.public_change: {role:enforcer_picket} moves to interdict the flight corridor leading from the centrifuge to the station exchange concourse.

missions.reason: She needs the syndicate repo ship disabled before its grapples seize the transport shuttle carrying her breeding stock.
missions.private_fact: The repo captain hails offering thirty thousand credits and guaranteed grazing permits if the pilot hands over the cryo-canister.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the repo tug and tables the usury audit.
resolutions.summary: The pilot disables the repo tug and tables the usury audit. {role:orbital_herder} voids the debt contract, preserving her dairy centrifuge and certified breeding lines.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot disabled a syndicate repo tug in high orbit to stop an independent cattle rancher from losing her herd.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the embryo vault for the syndicate bounty.
resolutions.summary: The pilot surrenders the embryo vault for the syndicate bounty. {role:livestock_syndicate} sells the breeding straws to off-system corporations, and {role:orbital_herder} loses her ranch.

consequences.public_summary: Station whispers claim a hired pilot took syndicate cash to hand over the last purebred dairy embryos on the station.

resolutions.reached_by: The audit fails or the pilot abandons the herder.
resolutions.summary: {role:livestock_syndicate} repossesses {role:herder_centrifuge} and evicts the dairy workers. The pedigree embryo straws thaw and spoil during transport, wiping out the genetic line.

loose_threads.detail: The seized loan folder contains a promissory coupon stamped with the seal of a syndicate holding company dissolved nine years ago.
An off-world biotech distributor posted a pre-order for thirty centrifugal heifer embryos three days before the foreclosure notice appeared.
The repo picket displays welded hull patches over the obliterated insignia of an independent miners cooperative.

radio_hooks: Agricultural exchange opens bidding on distressed orbital livestock assets.
Centrifuge herders protest utility cutoffs outside station administration offices.
Syndicate legal factors reaffirm lawful rights of asset recovery across outer rings.

voice_direction.orbital_herder: Blunt, weary, and protective. Uses practical livestock terminology and speaks with flat determination, never asking for pity.
voice_direction.debt_enforcer: Brisk, cheerful, and unyielding. Treats devastating foreclosures like ordinary accounting adjustments and quotes contract clauses from memory.
